packageRules.description: Pin devDependencies exactly; let runtime deps float within their range.
Automerge minor and patch bumps once CI is green.

Never auto-bump react-router. SECURITY.md documents an accepted advisory whose only real fix is a v8 migration, and an automated bump would either reintroduce GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6 or break every react-router-dom import.
